From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rebecca Li <rebecca@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline clearance & close-velocity agenda — final forecast pass

Team,

This is the final pass for the weekly forecast. Finance will lock numbers at EOD Friday; I need the accuracy window tightened to avoid last-minute adjustments. Please do the following before our 11:00 AM PT sync (link below):

- Update stage to the correct close state (Commit / Best Case / At-Risk). If a deal is closing this quarter, move to Commit and add the expected sign date.
- For any At-Risk deals, add a one-line reason in the CRM notes and assign probability (10/30/60/90).
- Confirm ARR amounts match the most recent commercial offer (attach the PDF if changed).
- Mark any soft-commit deals where legal/PO is outstanding and add expected PO date.

Agenda (20 min):
1) Quick clearance (round-robin): which deals move to Commit? (8 min)
2) Two rapid deep dives (Markus: ACME, Monica: CloudWave) — blockers & next steps (8 min)
3) Any outsized risks to call out to Finance (2 min)

Attachments: forecast-template.xlsx (please use this to validate numbers), close-plan.md (suggested script for ACs), ACME-proposal-v3.pdf (client-facing doc).

Link: https://meet.redwood.com/weekly-forecast-20270418

Please update HubSpot and drop a one-line update here if you change a deal after the call.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

Quick note on ACME: I pinged Rebecca this morning for the PO ETA. If she confirms the 4/22 PO, I’ll mark RW-ACME-1420 as Commit.

See you at 11.

Thanks Neha — a couple of updates from my side before the call:

- RW-ACME-1420 (ACME): Proposal was sent 4/12. Rebecca indicated legal review is done; they have one internal procurement signature left. Rebecca, can you confirm if procurement will sign by 4/22? If yes, I’ll set to Commit with a 90% probability.
- RW-CW-981 (CloudWave): They requested a pricing tweak yesterday. Monica, do you have the updated quote ready? If it’s larger than $75k ARR we should move to Best Case until pricing is finalized.

I will also reconcile the numbers in forecast-template.xlsx and attach a short reconciliation note to the deal record. If anyone updates a number after 2 PM PT, flag it here so Finance is aware.
